title: Zesty Salty Korean Eggs Naengmyeon
description: A refreshing and savory Korean dish featuring eggs, yuzu-cure, and glassy jelly noodles, perfect for warm weather. This crowd-pleasing naengmyeon is a must-try for anyone looking for a unique and flavorful meal.
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs, then slice them into thin rounds.
Mix the yuzu juice, kosher salt, and granulated sugar in a small bowl until the sugar is dissolved.
Add the sliced eggs to the yuzu mixture and let it cure in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours.
Cook the naengmyeon noodles according to the package instructions, then rinse them in cold water.
Mix the rice vinegar, sesame oil, and a pinch of kosher salt in a large bowl.
Add the cooked noodles to the bowl and toss them in the vinegar mixture until they are well coated.
Slice the cucumber into thin rounds and add it to the bowl with the noodles.
Add the pickled ginger and toasted sesame seeds to the bowl and toss everything together.
Add the cured egg slices to the bowl and toss gently to combine.
Serve the Zesty Salty Korean Eggs Naengmyeon immediately, garnished with additional toasted sesame seeds if desired.
